title: Count the fewest steps
prompt: Return the fewest connections that must be followed to get from one name to another. Return 0 when they are the same name, and -1 when there is no route.
hints: How many steps away is a newly found name, in terms of the name it was found from?
Keep a Map from each seen name to its number of steps. A new neighbour is one step further than the name being explored.
Run a breadth-first search from the first name. Return the recorded steps when you reach the target, and -1 when the queue runs out.
checkLabels: A name is 0 steps from itself.
Names in different groups have no route.
The search works from any starting name.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Counts how many names were explored instead of how far away the target is.
Returns 0 when there is no route.

feedback: Record a number of steps for each name when it is first found. The answer is that number for the target, not a count of the work done.
